# Every module Ljós implements, as its native types and the QML files of its
# style declare them, in the format of `qt_types` (see that crate's
# documentation). Nothing in it comes from Qt's description of its types.
#
# Do not edit: `crates/ljos_cli/tests/own_types.rs` writes this file from a
# running engine, and fails when it is not what the types declare now.
#
#     LJOS_OWN_TYPES=write cargo test -p ljos_cli --test own_types
#
# The order things are built in, which is not a circle because this text is
# committed: `qt_types` compiles this file in; `ljos_controls`' build script
# compiles the style's QML against it; the command above links the runtime
# and writes this file. After a native member is added that a style file
# uses, a build without Qt's table needs the command twice: once to write
# the native types (the style does not compile yet and is left out), once
# more for the style's own. The command says when that is so.

module Ljos
	ErrorBoundary Ljos.ErrorBoundary
	SelectionScope Ljos.SelectionScope
	type Ljos.ErrorBoundary ErrorBoundary
		prototype QtQuick.Item named
		default content
		prop content QtQml.Component named pointer
		prop fallback QtQml.Component named pointer
		prop item QtQml.QtObject named pointer readonly
		prop failed QtQml.bool named readonly
		prop fault Ljos.ErrorBoundaryFault pointer readonly
		prop catchExceptions QtQml.bool named
		prop maxRestarts QtQml.int named
		prop within QtQml.int named
		prop restarts QtQml.int named readonly
		signal contentChanged
		signal fallbackChanged
		signal itemChanged
		signal failedChanged
		signal catchExceptionsChanged
		signal maxRestartsChanged
		signal withinChanged
		signal restartsChanged
		method retry
	type Ljos.SelectionScope SelectionScope
		prototype QtQuick.Item named
		prop selectedText QtQml.string named readonly
		prop selectionStart QtQml.int named readonly
		prop selectionEnd QtQml.int named readonly
		prop selectionColor QtQuick.color named
		prop selectByMouse QtQml.bool named
		signal selectedTextChanged
		signal selectionStartChanged
		signal selectionEndChanged
		signal selectionColorChanged
		signal selectByMouseChanged
		method select
		method selectAll
		method deselect
		method copy
		method positionAt
		method linkAt
	type Ljos.ErrorBoundaryFault ErrorBoundaryFault
		is uncreatable
		prop kind QtQml.string named readonly
		prop message QtQml.string named readonly
		prop file QtQml.url named readonly
		prop line QtQml.int named readonly
		signal kindChanged
		signal messageChanged
		signal fileChanged
		signal lineChanged
